'''Roogar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he traveled to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] along with a group of other Wookiees, and they purchased large quantities of [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] and other explosives.<ref name="Living Force" />

Roogar had a dark-colored stripe of fur running down the side of his body.<ref name="Living Force" />
